data_point: Uses Stripe for billing or subscription revenue
run_when: Code found Stripe mentioned but not in a way that proves usage.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company uses Stripe for its own billing or subscription revenue.
prompt.definition: Stripe processes the company's own customer payments.
yes_when: Privacy policy or terms name Stripe as their payment processor or sub-processor
Checkout or billing runs on Stripe
no_when: The text names a different payment processor as their only one
unknown_when: Stripe is only named as an integration, investor or partner
watch_out_for: 'Connect your Stripe account' describes their product, not their billing
Stripe as an investor is not usage

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

good_sources: pages on the company's own domain

examples.input_excerpt: We use Stripe to process payments. Stripe's privacy policy applies to payment data.

output.evidence_quote: We use Stripe to process payments.
output.reason: The company names Stripe as its payment processor.
